lines.say: Did you know these five jobs pay over a hundred thousand dollars a year?
lines.show: Did you know these 5 jobs pay over $100,000 a year?

lines.say: And none of them needs a four-year degree.
lines.show: And none of them needs a 4-year degree.

lines.say: Number five. Radiation therapist. Over one hundred five thousand. You can start with a two-year degree.
lines.show: #5. Radiation therapist. Over $105,000. You can start with a 2-year degree.

lines.say: Number four. Elevator installer. Almost one hundred ten thousand, and you get paid while you train.
lines.show: #4. Elevator installer. Almost $110,000, and you get paid while you train.

lines.say: Number three. Nuclear reactor operator. Almost one hundred twenty-three thousand, with a high school diploma and a federal license.
lines.show: #3. Nuclear reactor operator. Almost $123,000, with a high school diploma and a federal license.

lines.say: Number two. Commercial pilot. Over one hundred twenty-three thousand, after flight training.
lines.show: #2. Commercial pilot. Over $123,000, after flight training.

lines.say: And number one. Air traffic controller. Over one hundred forty-eight thousand.
That's almost three times what the typical American worker makes.
lines.show: That's almost 3x what the typical American worker makes.

scenes.heading: Median pay, May 2025
scenes.source: Data: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook

lines.say: Every one of these takes serious training.
But a bachelor's degree isn't the only road to six figures.

scenes.takeaway: There's more than one road to six figures.
